body_md:
People looking for an independently owned general contractor in Orlando can start with these five firms. Each holds a Certified General Contractor license that the Florida DBPR licensee lookup shows as Current, Active, and Florida filings used here show no parent company. Licensure dates, addresses, and stated service areas are the facts to compare.

## How we picked

Each firm was checked in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup for trade, license type, license number, status, licensure date, expiration, and license-record address. Florida filings were checked for officer names and whether a parent company is shown. A firm’s own site, when one is listed, was used only for the ownership wording in that entry. License facts link to the DBPR license detail page. Phones and websites appear only when listed. Contacts were checked on November 25, 2026.

## At a glance

- All five licenses are Current, Active Certified General Contractor licenses expiring August 31, 2028: CGC1507856 (Hardwick General Contracting, Inc.), CGC017011 (Ruby Builders, Inc.), CGC062542 (G & M Construction Services, Inc.), CGC056662 (C.G.R. Construction Co. Inc.), and CGC026759 (Orlacon General, Inc.).
- DBPR licensure dates are July 2, 1980 (Ruby Builders), October 31, 1983 (Orlacon General), January 27, 1993 (C.G.R. Construction), August 14, 2001 (G & M Construction Services), and September 28, 2004 (Hardwick General Contracting).
- Hardwick states a service area of Orlando and Central Florida. Ruby Builders states Orlando, including commercial, educational, institutional, and governmental projects. Service area is not stated for G & M Construction Services, C.G.R. Construction, or Orlacon General.
- License-record locations are Maitland for Hardwick, Orlando for Ruby Builders and C.G.R. Construction, Orlando and Apopka for G & M Construction Services, and Orlando and Sanford for Orlacon General.

## Things to know before you go

On the linked DBPR page, match the firm name to the license number, status Current, Active, and expiration August 31, 2028.

Licensure date and years-in-business wording are separate facts. Hardwick was founded in 2004 and licensed on September 28, 2004. Ruby Builders is listed as since 1959, with licensure on July 2, 1980. G & M Construction Services was incorporated July 24, 2000 and licensed August 14, 2001. C.G.R. Construction was incorporated December 30, 1992 and licensed January 27, 1993. Orlacon General was licensed October 31, 1983 and incorporated July 15, 1985.

A phone and website are listed for Hardwick General Contracting, Inc. (407-519-3016, https://hardwickgc.com/, 253 N. Orlando Avenue, Suite 301, Maitland, FL 32751) and Ruby Builders, Inc. (407-293-8217, https://www.rubybuildersinc.com/, 3939 Silver Star Road, Orlando, FL 32808). No phone or website is listed in this data for G & M Construction Services, Inc., C.G.R. Construction Co. Inc., or Orlacon General, Inc. Their license addresses are 807 Silver Drive, Orlando, FL 32804 and 317 W. James Ave, Apopka, FL 32712; 11316 Boggy Creek Rd, Suite 104, Orlando, FL 32824; and 1026 W. Harvard St, Orlando, FL 32804 and 1731 Missouri Ave, Sanford, FL 32771.

President and qualifying licensee are not always the same person. At C.G.R. Construction Co. Inc., Sheryl Rebosio is president, Carlo G. Rebosio is vice president, and Carlo Guido Rebosio is the DBPR qualifying licensee. Hardwick’s site names Greg Hardwick (Gregory Michael Hardwick) president and owner and describes the firm as family-owned; the filing lists Gregory M. Hardwick as president and Donna W. Hardwick as vice president.

## FAQ

### Are these licenses current?

Yes. Each is a Certified General Contractor license with status Current, Active on the Florida DBPR licensee lookup, and each expires August 31, 2028.

### What does independently owned mean here?

Florida filings checked for these firms list individual officers and show no parent company. Filing officers include Gregory M. Hardwick and Donna W. Hardwick, Alec Suberman and Lee Suberman, Gary W. Bridges (sole officer, title DP, and registered agent), Sheryl Rebosio and Carlo G. Rebosio, and Christopher Edson and Melinda G. Edson. DBPR qualifying licensees named for Ruby Builders, G & M Construction Services, C.G.R. Construction, and Orlacon General are Alec J. Suberman, Gary Wayne Bridges, Carlo Guido Rebosio, and Christopher E. Edson.

### Which firms list a phone or website?

Hardwick General Contracting, Inc. lists 407-519-3016 and https://hardwickgc.com/. Ruby Builders, Inc. lists 407-293-8217 and https://www.rubybuildersinc.com/. G & M Construction Services, Inc., C.G.R. Construction Co. Inc., and Orlacon General, Inc. do not list a phone or website in this data.
